chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: This utterance of Amīr al-mu’minīn has already appeared in an earlier Sermon (172), but I have repeated it here because of the difference of versions.

key_terms.الشَّرِيفُ: The Noble One, referring to As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī

ai.seo_question: Why did As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī repeat a sermon already included in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī explicitly notes the repetition of this narration from Imam Ali to address the discrepancy between two distinct chains of transmission, a common editorial technique in Nahj al-Balagha to preserve textual integrity. This highlights the scholarly rigor applied to the compilation, ensuring that variations in the report of the Quraysh's excesses are documented for precise historical and jurisprudential analysis.
